name: 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin and 12-HETE biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern 12-lipoxygenase conversion of arachidonate to 12-HETE derivatives and hepoxilins/trioxilins, unlike confusables centred on 5-/15-lipoxygenase lipoxins, omega-oxidation or skin barrier lipids.

name: Cranial nerve development and neuronal migration
rationale: Members cover trigeminal, facial, olfactory and branchiomotor nerve development plus GnRH and hindbrain tangential neuron migration, distinguishing them from trunk peripheral/DRG neuron and inner-ear/sensory-organ confusables.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation and migration in wound healing
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte/epithelial proliferation and migration, epidermal spreading, wound inflammation and IL-20 family signalling, whereas confusables emphasise keratinocyte differentiation, apoptosis and adhesion.

qualifier: assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux
name: Plasma lipoprotein lifecycle and cholesterol transport
rationale: Members span chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance plus ABC-transporter cholesterol efflux and intestinal lipid absorption, distinct from confusables adding SREBP control, receptor internalization or vitamin E transport.

name: Calcium-triggered synaptic vesicle fusion and spontaneous release
rationale: All members regulate the calcium-dependent fusion step of neurotransmitter exocytosis, including spontaneous release, unlike confusables covering vesicle docking/priming, transmitter-specific release cycles or presynaptic calcium and plasticity.

name: Transferrin-mediated cellular iron uptake and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover transferrin endocytosis, DMT1 (SLC11A2) iron import and iron homeostasis, distinguishing them from confusables built on heme scavenging or oxygen and redox responses.

qualifier: regulation of protein import and export
name: Regulation of protein nuclear import and export
rationale: Members regulate protein import into and export from the nucleus, including SARS-CoV host-signalling pathways that target this traffic, unlike confusables on nuclear pore structure, RNA/ribosome export or PML/senescence.

qualifier: pesticides, heavy metals and aryl hydrocarbon receptor ligands
name: Response to pesticides, heavy metals and dioxin-like toxicants
rationale: Members are responses to herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, lead, mercury, cobalt, bisphenol A, genistein and TCDD/AhR signalling, unlike confusables on vitamins, oxidative stress or ethanol/nicotine/anesthetics.

name: Osteoblast and osteoclast regulation of bone remodeling
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and osteoclast differentiation and proliferation, mineralization, resorption and mesenchymal stem cell fate (with Wnt signalling), distinct from confusables on tendon/trabecula, IGF/FGF23-phosphate or BMP/TGF-beta programmes.

name: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation of straight and branched-chain fatty acids
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of very-long, long, medium-chain and branched (pristanoyl-CoA) fatty acids, unlike confusables on alpha-oxidation, ABCD1/peroxisome maintenance or essential fatty acid metabolism.

qualifier: Notch and ERBB4 intracellular domain release
name: Proteolytic release of Notch and ERBB4 intracellular domains
rationale: Members concern receptor processing and intramembrane cleavage that release NOTCH1-4 and ERBB4 intracellular domains to the nucleus, unlike confusables on Notch target transcription, Hedgehog processing or Wnt destruction complex.

name: Brainstem and pons development with respiratory control
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/brainstem and pons development and maturation plus neural control of respiration, distinct from cranial nerve, cerebellar/forebrain and spinal cord confusables.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and recruitment
rationale: Members combine formyl peptide receptor signalling with neutrophil/granulocyte chemotaxis and recruitment, unlike confusables on degranulation, extravasation or macrophage chemokines.

name: Drug ADME and amino acid conjugation of xenobiotic acids
rationale: Members are drug ADME pathways (aspirin, paracetamol, statin, prednisone, ciprofloxacin) with glycine/glutamine conjugation and CYP2E1 reactions, unlike confusables on sulfonation, acetylation/methylation or organic anion transport.

qualifier: amino acids, peptides and urate in epithelia
name: Epithelial SLC transport of amino acids, peptides and urate
rationale: Members are SLC transporters and their defects moving amino acids, oligopeptides, urate and organic anions across epithelial membranes (aminoacidurias, hypouricemia), distinct from hexose, organic cation and ornithine-centred confusables.

name: Leukotriene biosynthesis, catabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover leukotriene and eoxin synthesis, LTB4 catabolism and leukotriene transport, unlike confusables on lipoxins, P450 HETE/EET or leukotriene receptor signalling.

qualifier: left-right patterning, fluid clearance and sperm
name: Motile cilia in left-right patterning, fluid clearance and sperm
rationale: Members concern motile cilium/axoneme assembly (dynein arms, central apparatus, multiciliogenesis) and its roles in left-right asymmetry, CSF and mucociliary flow and sperm motility, unlike confusables on intraflagellar transport and primary cilia.

name: Iron homeostasis with oxygen sensing and redox responses
rationale: Members combine iron import and homeostasis with oxygen detection, superoxide removal and selenium response, unlike confusables centred on transferrin, heme scavenging or vitamin C.

qualifier: gas exchange, Rh ammonium and lactate transport
name: Erythrocyte gas exchange with Rh ammonium and lactate transport
rationale: Members cover erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and NO transport, Rh glycoprotein ammonium transport and basigin-linked monocarboxylate transport, unlike heme/iron or surfactant confusables.

name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA dehydrogenase beta-oxidation cycles
rationale: Members are the stepwise mitochondrial acyl-CoA dehydrogenase beta-oxidation cycles from palmitoyl- to acetyl-CoA, unlike confusables on carnitine shuttle, ketone bodies or peroxisomal oxidation.

name: G2/M transition and cyclin B-CDK1 checkpoint control
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, the G2/M checkpoint and Chk1/Chk2 control of cyclin B:CDK1, unlike confusables on E2F-driven G1/S, T-cell division or p53 DNA-damage signalling.

name: Mammary stem, luminal, alveolar and myoepithelial cell lineages
rationale: All members are developmental lineage programmes of mammary cell types, distinct from confusables on prostate/genital development or mammary branching and lactation.

name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain acyl-CoA oxidation and peroxisome maintenance
rationale: Members combine acyl-CoA oxidase VLCFA and fatty-acyl-CoA oxidation, ABCD1 deficiency, TYSND1 processing and peroxisome fission, unlike confusables on branched-chain/alpha-oxidation or peroxisomal protein import.

name: SLC4 and SLC26 bicarbonate and inorganic anion exchange
rationale: Members are bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide and oxalate transport by SLC4/SLC26 exchangers and their disease defects, unlike confusables on carbonic anhydrase, CFTR, phosphate or cation-chloride cotransport.

name: Cardiac desmosome assembly at the intercalated disc
rationale: Members link desmosome and intermediate-filament assembly to cardiomyocyte adhesion and ventricular action potential, unlike epithelial hemidesmosome, gap junction/T-tubule or sarcomere confusables.
